description: This file implements a ParallelPipeline class in Python for concurrent processing of frames through multiple sub-pipelines. It manages the creation, coordination, and lifecycle of these sub-pipelines, handling special frame types like StartFrame, EndFrame, and CancelFrame to ensure synchronized execution.

classes.name: ParallelPipeline
classes.description: A class that manages concurrent frame processing through multiple sub-pipelines, handling synchronization of lifecycle frames and providing setup and cleanup methods.

methods.name: __init__(self, *args)
methods.description: Initializes the ParallelPipeline instance, creating sub-pipelines from provided processor lists.

methods.name: processors(self)
methods.description: Returns the list of sub-pipelines contained within this parallel pipeline.

methods.name: List["FrameProcessor"] entry_processors(self)
methods.description: Returns the list of entry processors, typically the sub-pipelines.

methods.name: List[FrameProcessor] processors_with_metrics(self)
methods.description: Collects and returns all processors across sub-pipelines that support metrics collection.

methods.name: setup(self, setup: FrameProcessorSetup)
methods.description: Sets up the parallel pipeline and all its sub-pipelines asynchronously.

methods.name: cleanup(self)
methods.description: Cleans up resources for the parallel pipeline and all sub-pipelines asynchronously.

methods.name: process_frame(self, frame: Frame, direction: FrameDirection)
methods.description: Processes an incoming frame, coordinating execution across multiple pipelines and handling special lifecycle frames.

methods.name: _parallel_push_frame(self, frame: Frame, direction: FrameDirection)
methods.description: Pushes a frame to the pipeline if it hasn't been processed yet, avoiding duplicates.

methods.name: _pipeline_sink_push_frame(self, frame: Frame, direction: FrameDirection)
methods.description: Handles frames received from sub-pipelines, coordinating frame completion and synchronization.
